statusDetail: The requested bare short-link host consistently redirected to https://shope.ee/error_page. The audit therefore covers that reachable invalid-link error surface; no valid tokenized destination, catalog, checkout, or account flow was supplied.

page.notes: The entry URL 307 redirects cross-domain to a client-rendered generic error page.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark emulation remained a white surface with black text; computed color-scheme was normal and the CSS feature scan found no prefers-color-scheme rule.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the page exposed zero active animations and zero non-zero transitions.

checkOutcomes.method: forced-colors screenshot plus Lighthouse accessibility audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Forced-colors rendering kept the illustration and error text visible; Lighthouse reported no color-contrast violation.
The reached static error surface has no route/state control and therefore performs no abrupt state swap; active inventory found no transition interaction to mishandle.
The one-screen page has no scroll-linked motion or main-thread scroll animation; CSS and animation probes found no scroll animation implementation or active animation.
Active inventory found no pointer-driven custom gesture, carousel, disclosure, drag target, or platform-fighting gesture handler on the static surface.
The document fits one viewport and has no navigation chrome that remains static or obscures content while scrolling.
Active inventory found no tooltip, popover, menu, dialog, or manually positioned overlay that could drift from its anchor.
The one-screen error state presents a single centered message with no navigation movement or competing destination that loses the user’s attention.
Desktop and mobile initial states contain only the error message; no overlay, interstitial, banner, dialog, or popover obscures it.
No overlay or rich disclosure control is present.
checkOutcomes.reason: No overlay or rich control is present.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The surface is visually sparse and gives nearly all of the viewport to the error content, with no app frame or decorative chrome.
At 360x800, scrollWidth and clientWidth were both 360 with 0px horizontal overflow; the message reflowed legibly.
The reached page has one fixed error component and no reused component shown in differently sized containers.
checkOutcomes.reason: No reusable multi-container component is exposed on this surface.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has zero focusable elements, links, buttons, or inputs.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user input control exists on the reached surface.

checkOutcomes.method: first-viewport screenshot and DOM text inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The visible message clearly states that the requested page cannot be found; there are no competing calls to action.
The bare short-link domain contains no encoded destination or transaction flow to complete.
checkOutcomes.reason: A short-link token or product flow was not supplied, so there is no representative end-to-end task beyond handling the invalid root URL.

checkOutcomes.method: entry screenshot, redirect HAR, and control inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page identifies a not-found state but offers no home link, retry, back action, search, or other recovery control; DOM probe found zero links and buttons.
Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP/FCP at 4.48s (poor LCP); the trace corroborated a slower-than-needed 1.93s LCP in the local capture. CLS and TBT were 0.
The mobile layout observer measured CLS 0 with no shifts; Lighthouse also measured CLS 0.
The trace measured 0 long tasks and 0ms total blocking time; layout observation also recorded no long tasks.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary, live script attributes, and Lighthouse insights
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 307 redirect adds about 1.2s; all three parser-inserted scripts lack async/defer, and Lighthouse estimated 2.07s render-blocking savings plus 197KiB cache-lifetime savings.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse code coverage and HAR weight
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 134KiB unused JavaScript: 76.7% of the vendor chunk and 54.4% of React, disproportionate for a static error message.
There are no interactive controls, form fields, img or canvas elements requiring names/roles/labels; Lighthouse found no naming or role violation. The illustration is CSS decoration.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse contrast audit and forced-colors screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found no contrast violation, and the forced-colors capture retained visible text and illustration.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse axe audit and DOM landmark/heading probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reported no main landmark; the DOM contains no h1-h6 headings or landmarks, leaving the error message structurally unlabelled.
The short error text is centered, unclipped, and comfortably readable at 360px.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse meta-viewport audit and mobile layout
checkOutcomes.evidence: The viewport explicitly sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no; Lighthouse flags this as disabling zoom for low-vision users.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse console audit and HAR HTTP errors
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page logs a failed-resource error because /static/favicon.ico returns HTTP 404.
The rendered document has an HTML doctype, UTF-8 charset, viewport metadata, and no img elements with sizing/aspect-ratio defects.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse best-practices audits and DOM inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: Beyond the separately recorded favicon console error, Lighthouse found no deprecated API/paste/prompt issue; the page has no inputs and triggered no permission UI.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM metadata probe and Lighthouse SEO audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The title is the generic implementation label “mkt single page application” and no meta description exists.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM link inventory, robots fetch, and Lighthouse SEO audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has zero crawlable links, and /robots.txt returns the SPA HTML rather than valid robots directives; the viewport is present but disables scaling.
The requested URL 307-redirects to a generic cross-domain error page with no canonical; both robots.txt and sitemap.xml resolve to the same app shell instead of valid indexing resources.
The reached page is a generic error state rather than an article, product, organization, event, or other rich entity.
checkOutcomes.reason: This generic invalid-link error is not a rich entity that warrants structured data.

checkOutcomes.method: security headers, cookies, and HAR probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS is used and no cookies were set, but the main response lacks CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, framing protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.

checkOutcomes.method: trackers, cookies, secrets, and HAR probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: No known trackers, cookies, or exposed secrets were found. Requests go only to Shopee-controlled delivery/redirect hosts and total 232KB.
This error surface has no authentication flow and triggered no permission prompt.
checkOutcomes.reason: No authentication or permission-requiring feature is exposed.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No HSTS, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, or CSP defense is present.

checkOutcomes.method: discoverability no-JS comparison and raw HTML
checkOutcomes.evidence: Only 20% of rendered content tokens were present in raw HTML; #root ships empty and noscript says JavaScript is required, so the actual error explanation is unavailable without JS.
The small runtime reaches a stable visible error state without clipped overlays or an infinite spinner; the only runtime error is the separately recorded favicon 404.
This bare redirect/error endpoint is not an installable application surface and advertises no manifest.
checkOutcomes.reason: Installability is not proportionate for a short-link redirect/error endpoint.

checkOutcomes.method: invalid-route response, screenshot, and recovery-control inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The invalid root redirects to a generic 200 error page, but provides no useful recovery option and even returns the same SPA shell for robots.txt/sitemap.xml rather than meaningful HTTP failure semantics.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM language and CSS feature inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The English error text is correctly marked html lang=en; the compact centered layout has no directional control or reading-order defect.
No date, number, currency, duration, or locale-sensitive datum is rendered.
checkOutcomes.reason: No locale-sensitive data appears on this error page.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No times, events, recurrence, or time-zone-sensitive data is rendered.
checkOutcomes.reason: No time data appears on this error page.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The error surface has no consent wall, upsell, disguised ad, continuity trap, or manipulative control.
No form or validation flow exists.
checkOutcomes.reason: No form exists on the reached surface.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No input field exists.
checkOutcomes.reason: No input exists on the reached surface.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No checkout, subscription, consent, authentication, or account-management flow is exposed.
checkOutcomes.reason: No commercial or account flow exists on the reached surface.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR asset weights and image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The two decorative PNG resources total about 10KB, and no img element has oversizing, legacy-format, or responsive-source defects.
The static 51-character error state loads 211KB of JavaScript and Lighthouse identifies 134KiB as unused, making the implementation materially heavier than the task requires.
231,974 of 232,120 transferred bytes come from cross-origin Shopee delivery/redirect hosts, predominantly React/vendor JavaScript, disproportionate to a static error message.
The invalid-link error endpoint exposes no commerce/product action or other safe capability for an agent to invoke.
checkOutcomes.reason: This error endpoint has no agent-facing task or capability.

checkOutcomes.evidence: On-device inference would not improve this deterministic error message.
checkOutcomes.reason: AI inference is not proportionate to a static not-found response.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has no representative interaction to repeat; no synthetic interaction was fabricated.
checkOutcomes.reason: The static error page has no real repeatable interaction.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The loaded SPA error state retained 82,622 heap nodes and 4.29MB self size, a bounded single-state footprint with no evidence of runaway allocation.

checkOutcomes.method: heap constructor summary and interaction inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The baseline heap summary showed no Detached* constructor among the dominant populations; with no repeated interaction, no accumulating listener/timer path was present to exercise.

principleOutcomes.reason: Every defined check is inapplicable to the reached static error surface.

paths.description: Bare short-link entry and its reached generic error surface. Represents the only reachable archetype from the supplied URL. Tokenized destinations, product/listing templates, search, checkout, and account flows were not covered because no valid short-link token or credentials were supplied.

findings.evidence: The surface ignores prefers-color-scheme and remains hard-coded light.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and theme surface/text colors with light-dark() or a prefers-color-scheme rule.

findings.evidence: The not-found message is a dead end with no link, retry, search, or way back.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a clearly labelled recovery action such as “Go to Shopee”, “Try another link”, and a safe back action.

findings.summary: Bring LCP into the good range
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP/FCP at 4.48s for a minimal error page.
findings.suggestedFix: Render the error message in the initial HTML and remove the redirect/client-rendering dependency so LCP does not wait on JavaScript.

findings.evidence: A 307 redirect precedes three classic scripts with no async/defer; Lighthouse estimates 2.07s render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a small error document directly at the requested host; if scripts remain, defer non-critical code and set long immutable caching on hashed assets.

findings.summary: Stop shipping React/vendor code for the error page
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 134KiB unused JavaScript across React and the vendor bundle.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a static server-rendered error template with no framework runtime, or split an error-only bundle that includes only essential code.

findings.summary: Give the error page semantic structure
findings.evidence: The DOM has no main landmark and no heading; Lighthouse flags the missing main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap the error content in <main> and expose “Page not found” as an <h1>; keep DOM order aligned with the visual order.

findings.evidence: The viewport contains maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no, which Lighthouse flags for low-vision users.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and remove maximum-scale/minimum-scale/user-scalable restrictions.

findings.evidence: The favicon request returns 404 and produces a console error.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy the referenced /static/favicon.ico or update/remove the link so every requested asset resolves successfully.

findings.evidence: The title is “mkt single page application” and there is no meta description.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a user-facing title such as “Link not found | Shopee” and a concise description of what happened and what to do next.

findings.summary: Serve a valid robots.txt and crawlable recovery link
findings.evidence: /robots.txt returns HTML and the page has zero links.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve plain-text robots directives at /robots.txt and include a real href recovery link in the error HTML.

findings.evidence: The root cross-domain redirects to a generic 200 error page with no canonical; sitemap.xml also returns the SPA shell.
findings.suggestedFix: Return an appropriate 404/410 for invalid links, preserve the requested origin where possible, and serve valid robots/sitemap resources plus intentional canonical policy.

findings.evidence: The response lacks CSP, HSTS, nosniff, framing protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, strict referrer policy, and minimal Permissions-Policy.

findings.evidence: No browser policy header provides clickjacking, referrer, permissions, or origin/XSS defense.
findings.suggestedFix: Define frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, then tighten CSP and consider Trusted Types if the app injects HTML.

findings.summary: Render the error state without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Raw HTML ships an empty #root and only 20% rendered-token coverage; noscript tells users to enable JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the complete error heading, explanation, and recovery links in HTML, then layer optional enhancements on top.

findings.summary: Use intentional HTTP error and recovery behavior
findings.evidence: An invalid root becomes a generic 200 error state with no recovery, and infrastructure paths return the same shell.
findings.suggestedFix: Return truthful HTTP statuses, dedicated robots/sitemap responses, and an actionable error state with retry/home/back options.

findings.evidence: A 51-character message loads 211KB of JavaScript, 134KiB of which Lighthouse estimates is unused.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the error state as static HTML/CSS and avoid loading application/framework bundles until a feature needs them.

findings.evidence: Almost all 232KB transferred bytes are cross-origin Shopee assets, mostly framework code, for a static error response.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline the tiny critical error styles and eliminate cross-origin scripts; cache any remaining hashed assets for a long lifetime.

taskList.title: Replace the redirecting client SPA error with a direct server-rendered, semantic, recoverable error response
Restore zoom and add user-preference theming
Fix the missing favicon and eliminate console errors
